entities.summary: Pier Paolo Lucchetta is an Italian former volleyball player who competed in the 1984 Summer Olympics and in the 1988 Summer Olympics. He was born in Treviso. Four years later, he won the bronze medal with the Italian team in the 1984 Olympic tournament. He played all six matches.
